title: A thin rod hinged at the bottom of a tank of two immiscible liquids: the period of its small oscillations
summary: A thin rod of density rho, hinged at the bottom of a tank with liquid 6 rho up to L/2 and 2 rho above, stands upright and rocks when nudged. Buoyancy of each liquid and the weight give a restoring torque rho A g L^2 theta, I = rho A L^3/3, so T = (2 pi/sqrt 3) sqrt(L/g) - n = 1.73, timed by the run.
subject: Physics
topic: Small oscillations of a hinged rod in two immiscible liquids - buoyancy torques in layered liquids, moment of inertia and the period
subtopics: Buoyancy acts at the centre of each immersed part; in layered liquids each layer pushes on its own part
Torque about a hinge from vertical forces: F d sin(theta)
Moment of inertia of a rod about one end: M L^2/3
Small oscillations: omega^2 = (restoring torque per radian)/I
concepts: Lower half in 6 rho: buoyancy 3 rho A g L at L/4 gives (3/4) rho A g L^2 theta; upper half in 2 rho: rho A g L at 3L/4 gives (3/4) rho A g L^2 theta
The weight rho A L g at L/2 gives (1/2) rho A g L^2 theta the other way; net restoring torque rho A g L^2 theta
I = rho A L^3/3, so omega^2 = 3g/L and T = (2 pi/sqrt 3) sqrt(L/g): n = sqrt 3 = 1.73
The tilt-dependent submerged length L/(2 cos theta) changes the torque only at order theta^3
formulas: tau = [6 rho A (L/2) g (L/4) + 2 rho A (L/2) g (3L/4) - rho A L g (L/2)] theta = rho A g L^2 theta

methods: Solved independently: buoyancy torques (3/4 + 3/4) rho A g L^2 minus the weight's 1/2 give kappa = rho A g L^2; I = rho A L^3/3; omega^2 = 3g/L; n = sqrt 3 = 1.732
sympy: torques with the exact submerged length L/(2 cos theta); kappa = rho A g L^2; the correction is theta^3/3; n = sqrt 3
Nonlinear dynamics (scipy) with buoyancy integrated from the liquid pressure element by element: n = 1.7321 at 1 deg, independent of L; 12 deg gives about 1.74
Energy: the curvature of U(theta) in the layered liquid at 0 equals kappa
The page engine extracted and run in Node: kappa = 1, I = 1/3, answer 1.73; its timed runs agree
